item.subject: science
item.stem:
Kavya measures the temperature of cool water in a beaker with a laboratory thermometer. The thermometer has a bulb and a stem with a liquid column. She must place the bulb, keep the thermometer vertical, wait, and read at eye level.

Which method is correct?

options.A: Immerse the bulb without touching the beaker, keep the thermometer vertical, wait until the liquid column stops rising or falling, then read at eye level.
options.B: Immerse the stem and leave the bulb above the water, then read at eye level.
options.C: Rest the bulb on the beaker bottom to keep the thermometer steady, then read at eye level.
options.D: Wait until the liquid column stops, remove the thermometer from the water, then read it.
